integrity: Two standalone exact-integer verifiers enumerate every positive state below 8! and all 18 finite synchronization paths. Symbolic contraction and lifting arguments cover all positive inputs and arbitrarily long intervals.
scientific_limitations: Only basins of 34 and 1058 are addressed. No claim about the 1-happy basin, density, optimal intervals, or unverified independent corroboration.
title: Arbitrarily long fifth-power factoradic runs for two nontrivial attractors
